verdict.rationale: Angular is fully open-source on GitHub with CLI tooling (ng new, ng serve) that lets any developer run and build the entire framework/toolchain locally with no vendor-hosted dependency, satisfying self-hosting for a framework-type product. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party documentation framing 'self-hosting' as a named capability or discussing self-hosted SSR/Universal deployment specifics, and no independent verification of a fully self-hosted production deployment story.
